title: The Rival Hunter
text: Another hunter, alone, is after the same quarry and far better equipped than you, with a bow of black horn, a coat of scales and a pack of trophies. They suggest working together for an even split. Their hand never strays far from the bow.

options.label: Hunt together for an even split, keeping an eye on that bow.

outcomes.text: They are as good as they look, and they guard your flank.
At the end they take the trophy and run. You never saw the bow come up.

options.label: The quickest races them to the quarry to take the kill for the House.

outcomes.text: You get there first. They arrive in time to watch.

options.label: Rob them of their fine gear; a lone hunter out here will not be missed.

outcomes.text: The gear is very good. They will not be needing it, and you do not look back.
